spanish: Y cuando embiste buey a varón o a mujer, y muere, apedreando será apedreado el buey, y no se comerá su carne, y el dueño del buey *será* limpio.

units.es: Y cuando embiste buey a varón o a mujer, y muere, apedreando será apedreado el buey, y no se comerá su carne, y el dueño del buey *será* limpio.

grammarChanges: Reattached the predicate adjective 'limpio' (h02021028019, נָקִי) to 'el dueño' (h02021028017-018, וּבַעַל הַשּׁוֹר) instead of to 'el buey', because an article-less adjective cannot attributively modify the definite article-marked הַשּׁוֹר.
Added the article 'el' before 'dueño' for Spanish grammaticality.
Supplied an italicized copula *será* for the verbless Hebrew predicate clause, matching the future force of 'será apedreado' earlier in the same verse.
readerNote: Supplied the italicized copula *será* so that limpio predicates el dueño (the owner), not el buey (the ox), per the auditor's finding that article-less נָקִי cannot attributively modify the definite הַשּׁוֹר.
